items.difficulty_reason: Two short directions, each a composition of named cited results with one explicit construction (the pulled-back order); 17-line proof, no omissions.

primary.label: author thm environment with its own label equivwo (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 713-717

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the thm: Well-order both sets, take order-type isomorphisms, and use comparability of ordinals by inclusion to get an injection one way. Conversely, apply cardinal comparability to A and the Hartogs ordinal of A: an injection of A into that ordinal well-orders A by pulling back the membership order. (source lines 720-736)

contexts.label: context environment carried so the assumption is visible: source lines 712-712
